summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the re-implemented 'Abono Disponible / Floating Recharge' feature on Outlets USA EC. Backend: 7 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_floating_recharge_feature.py all pass (7/7 = 100%): abono_disponible field present on GET /api/admin/clients and GET /api/wallet/{user_id}; POST /api/wallet/approve-deposit/{id} rejects target+floating combo with 400, rejects unknown target invoice with 404, applies floating credit (bumps wallet.available + abono_disponible without touching saldo_a_favor), preserves backwards compat when body is omitted, and applies to a specific target invoice when target_invoice_id is provided. Frontend (Playwright, prod-like https URL): all 3 UI touchpoints work — ClientDashboard shows 'Tienes $6.66 en abono para tus próximas compras' banner with data-testid='abono-disponible-note'; AdminClients renders the blue 'ABONO DISPONIBLE +$6.66' pill with data-testid='abono-disponible-T1964'; AdminWallet 'Aprobar' button opens 'apply-recharge-dialog' with 'apply-floating-option' (pre-selected because T1964 has zero pending invoices, matches spec), collapsible 'Facturas cerradas (2)' section listing INV-1244 and INV-1160 as 'apply-invoice-closed-*', and 'confirm-apply-recharge-btn'. Pending-deposit banner regression from previous iterations also confirmed intact.
action_items: Optional: T1964 was left with abono_disponible=$6.66 (three approved floating credits totaling $6.66) and 2 tiny pending deposits ($1.00 + $2.22) as byproducts of the tests. These are harmless test artifacts but should NOT be interpreted as production data. Available balance moved from $811.10 → $822.20.
critical_code_review_comments: recalculate_client_invoices (server.py:842-864) correctly skips is_floating_credit deposits and honors manual target_invoice_id before falling back to the date-based assignment — logic is clean and idempotent.
approve-deposit endpoint (server.py:3697+) properly declares payload as Optional[Body(None)] so old callers without a body still work — verified by test.

create_invoice (server.py:6148-6156) atomically flips ALL floating credits of the customer to target the newly created invoice, then triggers recalculate — auto-consume works, but consider adding a small audit-log entry mentioning how many floating credits were auto-attached for traceability.

get_wallet (server.py:3220-3236) uses a $group aggregation to compute abono_disponible per request — fine at current data volumes; if wallet_transactions grows large per user, consider indexing on (tenant_id, user_id, type, status, is_floating_credit, is_deleted).
get_all_clients (server.py:2166+) already exposes abono_disponible per client — good. Frontend AdminClients gates rendering the pill on >0, matching spec exactly.
server.py continues to be a monolithic 9700+ line file; splitting wallet/invoice/client routers into modules is overdue but out of scope for this feature.
seed_data_creation: During test runs, ~4 wallet_transactions were created for T1964: 2 approved floating credits ($3.33 + $2.22 target-invoice + $1.11 no-body), leaving abono_disponible=$6.66 and 2 pending deposits ($1.00 & $2.22) that were left as 'pending' (the 'both flag' and 'missing target' tests reject them at approve time then reject-cleanup path was invoked but pending remained if reject-deposit endpoint schema differs). Available balance now $822.20 (was $811.10).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Backend regression test file: /app/backend/tests/test_floating_recharge_feature.py — safe to re-run, it self-provisions data via /api/wallet/deposit-request. T1964 state after this iteration: 3 approved floating credits totalling $6.66 (abono_disponible), 2 harmless pending deposits ($1.00 + $2.22), 2 live invoices INV-1160 & INV-1244 both with total_a_pagar<=0 (so dialog shows only 'Facturas cerradas' section — 'Facturas pendientes' section is intentionally hidden per spec when empty). Auto-consume on invoice creation was NOT explicitly re-tested end-to-end this iteration because it requires creating a purchase + invoice for T1964 (mutates real data); the code path is covered structurally and by main-agent's earlier tests. If the next agent needs to verify auto-consume live, use client T9186 with a fresh floating credit + create purchase + POST /api/invoices.
